curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the Japanese government tries to bury the truth about Godzilla's return, can they keep rival global powers from unleashing a catastrophic strike?
curatedMovie.description: After a fishing boat is destroyed at sea, the sole survivor identifies the attacker as a resurrected Godzilla, triggering a strict government cover-up as Cold War powers ready their own preemptive strikes on Japan.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful monster thriller driven by Cold War tension, high-pressure statecraft, and kaiju spectacle.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Koji Hashimoto recharges giant-monster destruction with Cold War paranoia, escalating from maritime dread into a high-stakes crisis between rival nuclear superpowers.
